name: Battle

components.pose: She stands with her tidepearl staff held high in one hand and her other arm sweeping out to command the water, cape and hair streaming, a calm, fierce gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A towering wave rears up behind her and curls over the harbour on her command, spray and glowing {{MAGIC}} water streaming around her, a whirlpool turning in the bay.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
